title: Promoted synthesis of spirooxindoles in the presence of chitosan containing an acidic ionic liquid bridge in aqueous medium
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45889-45908
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03286E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohadeseh Amiri, Narges Seyedi, Farhad Shirini, Hassan Tajik
CS-(M3SP)2-NH2·HSO4, was successfully utilized as a promoter in the synthesis of (±)-spiro[indoline-3,4′-pyrazolo[3,4-b]quinoline]dione and (±)-spiroindoline-pyrano[2,3-c]quinolone derivatives.
